blocks.heading: The beauty of balance is the idea of Diversity, The beauty of diversity is the idea of Balance.

blocks.leftColumn: To ensure that this diversity flourishes and the balance remains maintained, it is important to understand diversities in different spaces in our ecosystem.In this project,
blocks.rightColumn: I have focused on different spaces, species, events, hunting and Farming that are causing changes that tremble the balance of the ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Emperor Penguins / the ritual of resilience.

blocks.leftColumn: *The Emperor Penguin does not fear the cold, it understands it, & through this understanding, it lives.*
blocks.rightColumn:
The Emperor<ref n="01"/> Penguin family is a marvel of shared survival. The mother lays a single egg, then passes it, gently, precisely onto the father’s feet.

He will carry it for nearly five months, never letting it touch the frozen ground, balancing life on a patch of warm thin a world built on ice. In a crowd of 6,000 nearly identical bodies, the mother finds her family. Always. By sound, by memory, by the rhythm \[03] of survival passed down in silence.
